description_en: Creates and binds tags to specified China Office (Chinese: Wuying) delivery groups in compliance with Alibaba Cloud tag specifications. If a tag key already exists on a resource, the tag value is updated to the value specified in the current request. Currently, only delivery group (`APPINSTANCEGROUP`) resource types are supported
description_zh: 按阿里云标签规范为指定的无影交付组创建并绑定标签。资源上已存在相同标签键时，标签值会被更新为本次传入的值。当前仅支持交付组（`APPINSTANCEGROUP`）资源类型
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required. Set this parameter to the ID of the region where the delivery group resides, such as `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID，必填。传入交付组所在地域的 ID，例如 `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. This parameter is required. Currently, only delivery groups are supported. The value is case-insensitive. We recommend that you use uppercase letters.

Valid values:

APPINSTANCEGROUP: China Office (Chinese: Wuying) delivery group.

If you specify another value, the error code `InvalidResourceType.Invalid` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，必填。当前仅支持交付组，取值不区分大小写，建议使用大写形式：

`APPINSTANCEGROUP`：无影交付组。

传入其他取值时返回错误码 `InvalidResourceType.Invalid`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of resource IDs to which you want to bind tags. This parameter is required. Specify delivery group IDs. You can specify up to 50 IDs in a single request. Duplicate IDs are automatically deduplicated.

All IDs must be existing delivery groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account. If any ID does not exist or does not belong to the current account, the entire request fails and the error code `InvalidAppInstanceGroup.NotFound` is returned. No tags are bound to any resource
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定标签的资源 ID 列表，必填。传入交付组 ID，单次最多 50 个，重复的 ID 会自动去重。

所有 ID 必须是当前阿里云账号下已存在的交付组。 任一 ID 不存在或不属于当前账号时，整个请求失败并返回错误码 `InvalidAppInstanceGroup.NotFound`，不会为任何资源绑定标签
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter is required. The tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length and is case-sensitive. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` (case-insensitive) and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. Letters, digits, spaces, and common punctuation marks are supported. If the tag key does not comply with the rules, the error code `InvalidTagPolicy.KeyInvalid` is returned
fields.help_zh: 标签键，必填。长度为 1～128 个字符，区分大小写。不能以 `aliyun` 或 `acs:` 开头（不区分大小写），不能包含 `http://` 或 `https://`；支持字母、数字、空格及常见中英文标点。不符合规则时返回错误码 `InvalidTagPolicy.KeyInvalid`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. This parameter is required. The tag value must be 0 to 256 characters in length and is case-sensitive. An empty string is allowed. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. If the tag value does not comply with the rules, the error code `InvalidTagPolicy.ValueInvalid` is returned.

If the tag key is a system tag, the tag value can be only `true` or `false`
fields.help_zh:
标签值，必填字段。长度为 0～256 个字符，区分大小写，允许传入空字符串；不能包含 `http://` 或 `https://`，不符合规则时返回错误码 `InvalidTagPolicy.ValueInvalid`。

标签键为系统标签时，标签值只能为 `true` 或 `false`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags to bind. This parameter is required. You can specify up to 20 tags in a single request. Each tag must include both `Key` and `Value`.

Tag keys in the same request must be unique. Otherwise, the error code `InvalidTag.Duplicated` is returned.
If a tag key already exists on the resource, the tag value is updated to the value specified in the current request.
A maximum of 20 custom tags can be bound to a single resource. If this limit is exceeded, the error code `ResourceTag.CustomTagCountExceed` is returned.

Tag keys that start with `System/` are China Office (Chinese: Wuying) system tags. Only the following values are supported, and the tag value can be only `true` or `false`:

`System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`: the canary release tag for the delivery group.
`System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`: prevents newly bound users from establishing connections to the delivery group.

If you specify other tag keys that start with `System/`, the error code `InvalidTag.SystemTagKeyInvalid` or `InvalidTag.SystemKeyNotAllow` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的标签列表，必填。单次最多 20 个标签，每个标签必须同时传入 `Key` 和 `Value`。

同一请求中的标签键不能重复，否则返回错误码 `InvalidTag.Duplicated`。
资源上已存在相同标签键时，标签值会被更新为本次传入的值。
单个资源最多绑定 20 个自定义标签，超出时返回错误码 `ResourceTag.CustomTagCountExceed`。

以 `System/` 开头的标签键为无影系统标签，仅支持以下取值，且标签值只能为 `true` 或 `false`：

`System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`：交付组灰度标签。
`System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`：阻止交付组新绑定用户建连。

传入其他以 `System/` 开头的标签键时，返回错误码 `InvalidTag.SystemTagKeyInvalid` 或 `InvalidTag.SystemKeyNotAllow`
parameters.name: tag

schema.description_en: The response to this request. If the binding succeeds, only the request ID is returned
schema.description_zh: 本次请求的返回结果。绑定成功时仅返回请求 ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于定位请求问题
